name: Bracket sum
oneLiner: 2 to 4 glass tiles (glyph, label, a value that counts up) build in a row; a bracket draws under them into a big glass total pill, a glowing dot runs from each tile down the bracket and the total ticks up as each one arrives, then fills with the accent and punches
say: when the speaker adds a few numbers into one ("ads, sponsors and products: together that's $10,200 a month"): cut in on the first source; the total lands on the number they say. Set values, prefix and suffix to the real figures
